CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_account_hierarchy(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ select private.admin_account_hierarchy_impl(p_user_id) $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_active_user(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists(select 1 from public.profiles where id=p_user and account_status='active')
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_admin(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select
    p_user is not null
    and private.is_active_user(p_user)
    and coalesce((select auth.jwt()->>'aal'),'aal1') = 'aal2'
    and exists(select 1 from public.admin_users where user_id=p_user);
$function$
